newsitem.title: FRANCE: Essilor up strongly after sales figures.
newsitem.headline: Essilor up strongly after sales figures.

text.p: Essilor was up strongly on the back of its nine month sales and statements by the chairman of Saint-Gobain, Jean-Louis Beffa, dealers said.
At 1154 GMT, Essilor was up 3.72 percent at 1,421 francs.
"The nine month sales figure, published this morning, was in line with market expectations," said Patrick Leguil of Transbourse.
Another analyst said that recent statements by Beffa, reaffirming that he did not exclude closer ties between his glass group and the lens company, were not new.
But Leguil said that it "reminded investors that Essilor's strategy is good and that its financial situation is healthy despite recent acquisitions in the United States."
Essilor's nine-month sales figure was up 6.3 percent on a like-for-like basis to 5.737 billion francs.
